extName.description: Extension name in the browser and the stores. A brand name: keep it in English unless your script needs a transliteration.

extShortName.description: Short name, where the browser has little room (12 characters or fewer). A brand name: keep it as it is.

extDescription.message: Hands your browser downloads to the Whoosh download manager, with the same cookies and referrer.
extDescription.description: Store and extensions-page description. At most 132 characters.

optionsIntro.message: Changes are saved as you make them and apply at once.

storeNote.message: This is the browser-store edition. It does not catch, detect or download media on YouTube and similar streaming sites.

captureEnabledHelp.message: When off, every download stays in the browser. The toolbar button shows “off”.

captureIncognitoHelp.message: Off by default. Downloads from private windows are never remembered for self-healing.

minSize.message: Leave smaller files to the browser

minSizeUnit.description: Label of the KB/MB/GB menu (read by screen readers only).

minSizeHelp.message: 0 means no minimum. Files whose size is not known in advance are always sent.

minSizeInvalid.message: Enter a number of 0 or more.

fileTypes.description: File name extensions such as zip or mp4.

fileTypesHelp.message: Separated by spaces or commas, without the dot (zip iso mp4). Leave empty to catch every type.
fileTypesHelp.description: Keep “zip iso mp4” as it is: these are typed literally.

fileTypesEmpty.message: Every file type will be caught.

excludedSites.message: Never catch downloads from these sites

excludedSitesHelp.message: One per line, e.g. example.com. A site includes its subdomains.

excludedSitesInvalid.description: Shown under the list of excluded sites.

altClickLegend.description: Options section heading. Alt is the keyboard key.

altClickWhoosh.message: Send it to Whoosh, whatever the rules above say

sniffMedia.message: Detect audio and video on pages

sniffMediaHelp.message: Lists media files and streams in the toolbar popup, ready to download.

preconnect.message: Prepare the connection when the pointer rests on a download link

preconnectHelp.message: Only the site's address is passed to Whoosh, never the link itself.

selfHealingHelp.message: When a paused download's address has expired, Whoosh looks for the fresh one on the page it came from, and asks you when unsure.

saved.description: Shown briefly after a setting is saved.

popupChecking.description: Popup status while the connection is being checked.

popupNotConnected.description: Popup status: the native host is missing.

popupNoHost.message: The Whoosh native host is not installed.

popupAppNotRunning.description: Popup status: the host works but the Whoosh app is not running.

popupStartApp.message: Start Whoosh; downloads stay in the browser until then.

popupError.description: Popup status when the popup itself failed.

popupCaptureSite.description: Popup switch for the current site.

popupMediaEmpty.description: Popup: no audio or video found on the page.

popupDownload.description: Button next to a detected media file.

popupSent.description: The button after the file was handed to Whoosh.

popupFailed.description: The button after handing the file over failed.

popupLast.description: Popup footer: the last download the extension handled.

openSettings.description: Popup link to the options page.

altHintBrowser.message: Hold $KEY$ while clicking a link to let the browser download it.
altHintBrowser.description: $KEY$ is the Alt key, shown as a keyboard key.

altHintWhoosh.message: Hold $KEY$ while clicking a link to send it to Whoosh whatever the rules say.
altHintWhoosh.description: $KEY$ is the Alt key, shown as a keyboard key.

pageBlocked.message: Whoosh from the browser store does not work on this site.

healTitle.description: Popup section: downloads whose address expired.

healOpenPage.message: Whoosh needs the download page once more for $FILE$.

healConfirm.message: Is this the same file as $FILE$?
healConfirm.description: Followed by the address Whoosh found.

badgeOff.description: Toolbar badge when catching is switched off. At most 4 characters; shorter is better.

outcomeSkipped.description: Popup footer. $REASON$ is a technical code such as too-small.

outcomeKept.description: Popup footer. $REASON$ is a technical code such as timeout.

outcomeLinksSent.description: Popup footer after a context-menu download.

outcomeBlocked.description: Popup footer (browser-store edition on video sites).

error.example: no link list from the page

errorStoreBlocked.message: Whoosh from the browser store does not download from this site.

errorRefused.message: Whoosh did not accept that address.
errorRefused.description: Shown when the app refused the new address of an expired download.
